metric_name: 按性别及雇员类别划分的受训雇员百分比
query: 按性别及雇员类别划分的受训雇员百分比 按性别及雇员类别划分的受训雇员百分比 衡量企业培训资源的分配情况。指报告期内参加培训的雇员人数占该类别雇员总人数的百分比，需分别按性别（男、女）及雇员类别（如高级管理层、中级管理层、一般员工）进行细分披露。 A. 披露完整性得分 (权重 50%) 2分：完整披露了性别及所有层级类别的受训百分比。 1分：仅披露了整体受训百分比，或缺少其中一个维度（如缺性别划分）。 0分：未披露具体百分比数据。 B. 数据逻辑与口径得分 (权重 50%) 2分：披露了计算方法，且数据分布逻辑合理（如百分比不应无故超过100%）。 1分：仅给出数字，无计算口径说明。 0分：数据存在逻辑错误或未说明。 受训雇员百分比 培训覆盖率 按性别划分的培训 按雇员类别划分的培训 按职级培训 受训人数占比 员工培训统计 percentage of employees trained training coverage rate training by gender training by employee category training by job level trained employees workforce training statistics 是否按男/女披露受训雇员百分比？ 是否按高级管理层、中级管理层、一般员工等类别披露？ 计算口径与分母（该类别雇员总数）是什么？ 报告期是什么？ 数据是否存在明显逻辑异常（如无故超过100%）？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '按性别及雇员类别划分的受训雇员百分比'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 是否按男/女披露受训雇员百分比？ 是否按高级管理层、中级管理层、一般员工等类别披露？ 计算口径与分母（该类别雇员总数）是什么？ 报告期是什么？ 数据是否存在明显逻辑异常（如无故超过100%）？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有培训总时长或人均学时；仅有培训课程名称清单；仅有人才发展战略描述；仅有整体受训人数无百分比且无细分；区分：本指标是按性别与雇员类别细分的受训百分比披露；人才储备战略关注继任与高潜计划；平等机会措施关注选拔公平流程，不是培训覆盖率统计。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.text: For emergency management work, in order to protect the safety of employees and the public, and to reduce environmental damage and social impact, Ju Teng International and its Production Plants have formulated the 'Comprehensive Emergency Response Plan for Production Safety Accidents', which stipulates prior prevention, emergency response, on-the-spot disposition and the handling of the aftermath of the incident. results.section: RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE MANAGEMENT / Materiality identification and communication
results.text: During the Reporting Period, Ju Teng International strictly complied with the 'Anti-Unfair Competition Law of the People's Republic of China' to protect the fair competition market and stop unfair competition practices. Meanwhile, we remain committed to managing our business practices in accordance with the 'Responsible Business Alliance (RBA) Code of Conduct', and require that the management and all employees strictly abide by it. We have established this Code as a programmatic document to achieve the Company's professional ethics, honest operation and compliance goals. Ju Teng International had not provided trainings on ethics and anti-corruption for employees during the year due to the COVID-19 pandemic. In accordance with this Code, we have formulated the internal 'Business Ethics Management Procedure' to strictly manage the business ethics of our employees. We continue to provide channels such as telephone hotlines and emails for anyone to report corruption and immorality of our employees in real names or anonymously.
